intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn golden over the Indian Ocean. Perfect for couples seeking a romantic and intimate experience unique to the Maldives.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the most vibrant and pristine coral reefs in the world on a guided snorkeling safari. Swim alongside sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. A professional guide ensures safety and points out rare marine life, making it an unforgettable underwater adventure.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels revealing a breathtaking coral reef ecosystem. Enjoy a curated five-course gourmet meal featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine while fish and rays glide past your table — the ultimate luxury honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Ithaa Undersea Restaurant, Conrad Maldives Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline in electric blue hues. Walk hand-in-hand along the glowing beach, wade into the warm glittering water, and capture stunning photographs of this rare and romantic natural spectacle that the Maldives is world-famous for.

experiences.name: Traditional Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Tour
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut flatbreads. Follow the class with a guided village walk to explore local crafts, mosques, and the vibrant fishing culture of the islands.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline in electric blue hues. Walk hand-in-hand along the glowing beach, wade into the warm glittering water, and capture stunning photographs of this rare and romantic natural spectacle that the Maldives is world-famous for.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort bar. Take a quiet stroll along the beachfront to soak in the night atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight
meals.dinner: Grab a light late-night snack at the resort's 24-hour café or from your welcome amenity basket to keep costs low on arrival night

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your speedboat or ferry transfer in advance with Aegean Bliss Resort to avoid expensive last-minute arrangements. Keep USD cash handy for tips and small expenses on arrival. The late arrival means rest is the priority tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in to recover from travel. After a leisurely wake-up, head to the resort beach for a free morning swim and explore the house reef just off the beachfront. Snorkel directly from the shore to spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations — no boat needed, keeping costs at zero.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent snorkel gear from the resort's water sports center (budget option vs. guided tours) and continue exploring the house reef independently. Walk the full perimeter of the island to get your bearings and discover quiet spots. Visit the resort's dive center to browse upcoming budget snorkeling excursion packages for the week.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the spectacular Indian Ocean sunset from the beachfront. Enjoy the Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — after dark, witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline as waves crash. This is a free, unforgettable experience unique to the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — included or opt for the local guesthouse café nearby for fresh fruit, roti, and tea at a fraction of the cost
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic from the resort's grab-and-go counter or local snack shop: fresh coconut, local short eats (hedhikaa), and water
meals.dinner: Dine at the resort's casual beachside restaurant. Order local Maldivian fish curry with rice (mas riha) — one of the most affordable and authentic dishes on any resort menu

day_by_day.notes: The house reef snorkeling is completely free and rivals paid excursions. The bioluminescence is best viewed on darker nights away from resort lighting — walk to the quieter end of the beach after 21:00 for the best display.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning sunrise yoga or meditation on the beach (free, self-guided). After breakfast, join a budget group snorkeling boat trip organized by the resort — group tours are significantly cheaper than private charters. Explore a nearby coral reef known for manta ray and reef shark sightings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby local island by public ferry or shared boat (extremely budget-friendly). Explore the local village, browse small shops for handmade Maldivian souvenirs like lacquerware and woven crafts. Swim at the local island's bikini beach — a designated area for tourists.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort before sunset. Enjoy cocktail hour at the beach bar (opt for local soft drinks or coconut water to save money). Stroll the beachfront as stars emerge and keep an eye out for more bioluminescence along the shore.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local café — fresh papaya, scrambled eggs, and Maldivian black tea
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island café for an authentic and very affordable Maldivian meal: tuna sandwich (kulhi boakibaa) and fresh juice for under $5 USD
meals.dinner: Resort casual dining — grilled fresh catch of the day with steamed rice and salad. Ask the chef what fish came in that morning for the freshest and often most affordable option

day_by_day.notes: Local island visits are one of the best budget strategies in the Maldives — food and transport costs drop dramatically compared to resort-only dining. Always carry a light scarf or sarong to respect local dress codes on inhabited islands.

day_by_day.morning: Self-guided morning snorkel session from the beach focusing on underwater photography using a waterproof phone case or rented underwater camera. The house reef at Aegean Bliss offers excellent visibility in morning light. Look for octopus, lionfish, and parrotfish in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax with a romantic afternoon on your private beachfront — set up a shaded spot with beach towels, read, nap, and enjoy the turquoise lagoon views. This is a perfect low-cost honeymoon afternoon. Optionally join a free resort activity such as a coconut husking demonstration or Maldivian craft workshop.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a DIY romantic beach picnic dinner — purchase items from the resort's deli counter (cheeses, fruits, bread, local sweets) and set up on the beach. This is far more affordable than a formal private dining experience and equally romantic under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter and local flatbread with honey at the resort café
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort pool bar — fish tacos or a fresh coconut with snacks
meals.dinner: DIY beach picnic with resort deli items: local cheese, fresh fruit, Maldivian sweet bread (roshi), and a bottle of sparkling juice — romantic and budget-friendly

day_by_day.notes: For honeymooners on a budget, a self-arranged beach picnic creates an incredibly romantic atmosphere without the premium price tag of resort-organized private dining. Ask resort staff to provide a blanket and some candles — many will oblige at no extra charge.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group sunrise fishing trip — traditional Maldivian handline fishing (rod fishing) from a local dhoni boat. This is one of the most affordable water activities available and a deeply authentic cultural experience. Trips typically depart at 05:30 and return by 08:30.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take your morning catch to the resort kitchen and ask if they can cook it for you (many resorts offer this service for a small fee, far cheaper than ordering from the menu). Spend the afternoon at the resort infinity pool or lagoon, enjoying the luxury atmosphere without spending extra.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — revisit the magical shoreline phenomenon. The experience changes nightly depending on wave activity and plankton density. Tonight, wade gently into the shallows to see the bioluminescence swirl around your feet for an unforgettable romantic moment.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing snack: banana and local tea. Full breakfast after returning from the fishing trip — resort buffet
meals.lunch: Your freshly caught fish cooked by the resort kitchen with rice and salad — a unique and memorable budget lunch
meals.dinner: Resort casual restaurant — Maldivian garudhiya (tuna broth soup) with rice, lime, chili, and onion. A traditional, healthy, and inexpensive local staple

day_by_day.notes: Book the sunrise fishing trip at least one day in advance through the resort activities desk. The cost is typically $15–$25 USD per person for group trips. Having your catch cooked by the kitchen is a wonderful honeymoon story and a genuine budget hack.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day snorkeling excursion to a more distant reef — book a group day trip through the resort or a local tour operator. These trips typically include 2–3 snorkeling stops, a sandbank visit, and a simple lunch. Group pricing makes this very accessible for budget travelers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Sandbank visit included in the day trip — enjoy the surreal experience of standing on a tiny white sand island surrounded entirely by ocean. Perfect for romantic photos and a honeymoon memory. Swim, snorkel, and relax in the crystal-clear water.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet evening walk along the beachfront. Treat yourselves to one special cocktail at the sunset bar to celebrate the halfway point of your honeymoon trip.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before the day trip departs
meals.lunch: Simple packed lunch provided on the group snorkeling boat — typically fresh fruit, sandwiches, and water
meals.dinner: Resort dining — splurge slightly with a shared seafood platter to celebrate a wonderful day. Split one main course and add a side to keep costs manageable

day_by_day.notes: Group snorkeling day trips are the single best value water activity in the Maldives. Costs range from $40–$70 USD per person including lunch, transport, and equipment — compare this to $200+ for private charters. Book 2 days ahead to secure spots.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and relaxation morning — sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and lounge on your beachfront accommodation's private stretch of sand. This is your mid-trip recovery day. Read, journal, or simply listen to the ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Free resort activity: attend a Maldivian cultural performance or bodu beru drumming demonstration if available. Alternatively, take a free guided nature walk around the island with a resort naturalist to learn about local flora, fauna, and coral conservation efforts.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni cruise — a short, affordable shared boat cruise during golden hour. Many local operators offer 1-hour sunset cruises for $15–$20 USD per person. Watch the sun dip below the horizon surrounded by the Indian Ocean with your partner.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent resort breakfast — fresh juices, eggs to order, and local pastries
meals.lunch: Resort beach grill — grilled corn, fresh fish skewers, and coconut water. Keep it light and casual
meals.dinner: Local restaurant on a nearby island (if accessible by evening ferry) or resort's most affordable dining option — Maldivian short eats platter as a shared starter followed by a simple main

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is intentionally slower to avoid activity fatigue on a 13-day trip. The Maldives is as much about stillness and connection as it is about activities — especially on a honeymoon. Embrace the pace.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling at the house reef before other guests are awake — the reef is most active and fish most visible in the calm early morning hours between 06:00 and 08:00. Look for sleeping reef sharks resting on the sandy bottom.
day_by_day.afternoon: DIY island exploration: rent a bicycle from the resort (if available) or walk to explore every corner of the island. Discover hidden lagoon views, quiet beaches, and natural mangrove areas. Free activity with maximum discovery potential.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — third visit to the glowing shoreline. By now you'll know the best spots on the beach. Bring a journal or simply lie on the sand and watch the stars above while the ocean glows below — a profoundly romantic honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Post-snorkel breakfast at the resort — smoothie bowl with tropical fruits and granola
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic from the resort store: local crackers, canned tuna (a Maldivian staple), fresh coconut, and tropical fruit
meals.dinner: Resort casual dining — vegetable curry with roshi flatbread. Vegetarian options are typically the most affordable items on resort menus

day_by_day.notes: Renting bicycles (approximately $5–$10 USD per day) is one of the best ways to explore larger resort islands without spending money on organized tours. Check with the resort activities desk the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Book a budget dolphin watching cruise — morning trips (departing 07:00) are typically cheaper than afternoon sessions and spinner dolphins are most active at dawn. Group boat trips cost approximately $20–$30 USD per person and are a highlight of any Maldives trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from dolphin cruise and spend the afternoon snorkeling the house reef one final time before the trip ends. Focus on the deeper sections of the reef for larger fish species. Alternatively, visit the resort's spa for a single affordable treatment like a 30-minute foot massage.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening stroll along the full length of the beachfront. Collect shells and coral fragments (dead only, never live coral) as free natural souvenirs. Find a quiet spot to sit together and watch the stars — the Maldives has virtually zero light pollution away from resort areas.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-cruise breakfast — toast, fruit, and tea
meals.lunch: Post-cruise resort lunch — fish burger and fresh lemonade at the beach grill
meals.dinner: Special honeymoon dinner: request a table closest to the water at the resort restaurant. Order the fresh catch of the day grilled simply with lime and herbs — elegant, fresh, and relatively affordable

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching is weather and season dependent. March is generally excellent in the Maldives with calm seas and good visibility. The resort activities desk can advise on the best local operators with the most reliable dolphin sightings.

day_by_day.morning: Morning free time — pack a bag and take the local public ferry to a nearby inhabited island for a full cultural immersion day. Public ferries cost as little as $1–$3 USD and run on scheduled routes between islands.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local island's Friday Mosque (Masjid), traditional cemetery, and local market. Purchase handmade souvenirs directly from local artisans — prices are a fraction of resort gift shops. Try local street food from small cafés and tea houses.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by late afternoon ferry. Spend the evening relaxing on the beachfront, reflecting on the cultural contrast between resort life and local Maldivian daily life. Optional: one final Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before departing for the local island
meals.lunch: Local island tea house — authentic Maldivian lunch: mas huni (tuna and coconut salad) with roshi flatbread and sweet black tea for approximately $3–$5 USD total
meals.dinner: Resort dining — celebrate your cultural day with a local-inspired dinner: Maldivian fish soup, grilled reef fish, and coconut rice

day_by_day.notes: Local island visits are the most culturally enriching and budget-friendly experiences available in the Maldives. Dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees) when visiting inhabited islands out of respect for the local Muslim community. This is non-negotiable and deeply appreciated by locals.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling excursion — book a group trip to a different reef system than previously visited. Target a reef known for whale shark or manta ray sightings if seasonally appropriate. March can be excellent for manta rays in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Lazy beach afternoon — your last full opportunity to simply be in the Maldives. Swim in the lagoon, float on the surface, and appreciate the extraordinary turquoise water. Take photos and video for memories. Begin mentally preparing for departure in two days.
day_by_day.evening: Splurge evening: treat yourselves to a slightly more indulgent resort dinner to celebrate your honeymoon. Choose a set menu or fixed-price dinner option which typically offers better value than ordering à la carte. Share a dessert as a sweet honeymoon celebration.

meals.breakfast: Full resort buffet breakfast — eat well before the morning excursion
meals.lunch: Snacks on the boat during the snorkeling excursion — pack your own fruit and nuts to avoid expensive boat bar prices
meals.dinner: Resort set menu dinner — a fixed price of approximately $30–$50 USD per person often includes starter, main, and dessert at better value than individual courses

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray snorkeling is typically best in the early morning when mantas feed near the surface. Confirm with the tour operator that they follow responsible wildlife guidelines — no touching, no chasing, maintain respectful distance from all marine life.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkel at the house reef — say goodbye to the fish, turtles, and coral that have become familiar over the past 12 days. Take underwater photos to document the reef. Return snorkel gear and settle any equipment rental bills.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin packing and organizing luggage. Check out time procedures with the resort front desk. Spend the remaining afternoon hours at the resort pool or beach, soaking in the last views of the Indian Ocean. Visit the resort gift shop for any final souvenirs — compare prices with what you found on local islands.
day_by_day.evening: Final Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — your last night in the Maldives. Make this one special: walk slowly, wade into the glowing shallows, and take a moment to sit together on the beach and reflect on the entire trip. A perfect final memory of your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy every last tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Light resort lunch — keep it simple as you're packing and preparing
meals.dinner: Final dinner at the resort — order your favorite dish from the past 12 days. Toast to your honeymoon with a coconut cocktail or sparkling water with lime

day_by_day.notes: Settle your resort bill this evening to avoid morning rush on departure day. Confirm your transfer time to the airport with the front desk — allow at least 3 hours before your departure flight for speedboat/ferry transfer plus airport procedures in the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beachfront — wake early for one last Maldivian sunrise over the Indian Ocean. Take photos, breathe in the salt air, and appreciate the extraordinary experience of 13 days in one of the world's most beautiful destinations. Complete checkout formalities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange resort transfer to Velana International Airport per your confirmed departure schedule. Allow ample time for the speedboat or seaplane transfer plus airport check-in, immigration, and security. Browse duty-free at the airport for any last-minute gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives carrying extraordinary honeymoon memories, underwater photographs, and the glow of 13 days in paradise — all achieved on a budget-conscious plan without compromising on romance or experience.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before checkout — fresh fruit, pastry, and coffee
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café at Velana International Airport — budget for approximately $10–$15 USD for a simple meal before your flight
meals.dinner: In-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Keep $50–$100 USD cash reserve for departure day expenses: tips for resort staff who made your stay special, airport meals, and any unexpected transfer costs. Tipping resort housekeeping and boat crew is customary and deeply appreciated. Safe travels and congratulations on your honeymoon!

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - Late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, enjoy a welcome drink and a light welcome amenity prepared by the resort. Freshen up and settle in.

meals.breakfast: N/A
meals.lunch: N/A
meals.dinner: Light late-night welcome snack platter arranged by the resort upon check-in (complimentary welcome amenity). If hungry, order from the resort's 24-hour in-room dining menu — try a light Maldivian short-eat platter with tuna rolls and coconut sambol.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — you are arriving very late. Confirm your transfer with the resort at least 48 hours before arrival. Pack a carry-on snack for the flight in case you are hungry on arrival. Tip the transfer crew. Set an alarm for a relaxed morning start the next day.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Wake up to your first sunrise over the Indian Ocean from your beachfront villa. Enjoy a long, relaxed breakfast at the resort's main restaurant. After breakfast, take a slow walk along the beach to orient yourself with the resort grounds, locate the water sports center, spa, and restaurants. Dip your toes in the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's house reef for your first introductory snorkel session. Rent snorkel gear from the water sports center and explore the colorful coral gardens just steps from your beachfront villa. Spot reef fish, parrotfish, and possibly a sea turtle. Return to the beach and relax on a sun lounger with a fresh coconut. Optional: Book a couples' spa treatment for later in the trip.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach with a cocktail in hand. Head to the resort's signature overwater bar for sunset drinks. Dine at the resort's beachfront restaurant for a romantic candlelit dinner under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, and Maldivian mashuni (tuna and coconut). Mid-range resort buffet.
meals.lunch: Light beach grill lunch at the resort's casual beach shack — grilled fish sandwich, fresh salad, and a lime soda.
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — order the grilled catch of the day with saffron rice and a shared dessert platter. Budget approx. $60–$90 for two.

day_by_day.notes: This is your orientation and recovery day after the late arrival. Do not over-schedule. Use this day to book upcoming experiences like the Sunset Dhoni Cruise and Underwater Restaurant Dining for later in the trip. Apply reef-safe sunscreen before every water activity.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari. This excursion departs from the resort's water sports jetty and takes you by boat to some of the most pristine coral reefs in the area. A certified guide leads the group to multiple snorkel spots, pointing out sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and vibrant coral formations. Duration approximately 3 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a light lunch. Spend the afternoon relaxing on your private beachfront stretch. Optional: Rent a kayak or stand-up paddleboard from the water sports center and paddle around the calm lagoon. Alternatively, visit the resort spa for a 60-minute couples' massage to unwind after the morning's adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise. Board a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with tropical flowers and candles. Sail into the golden horizon as the sun sets, sipping Champagne and enjoying a curated canapé spread. The cruise lasts approximately 90 minutes and is one of the most iconic romantic experiences in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the snorkeling safari — grab fresh fruit, yogurt, and a coffee from the resort's grab-and-go breakfast station.
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's poolside café — fish tacos, fresh tropical juice, and a shared hummus platter.
meals.dinner: After the Sunset Dhoni Cruise, dine at the resort's overwater restaurant — grilled lobster or barramundi with coconut curry sauce. Budget approx. $70–$100 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari at least 1 day in advance through the resort's activities desk. The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise should be pre-booked — confirm the exact sunset time for March 17 (typically around 18:15 local time) to ensure the cruise timing aligns. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for the snorkeling safari.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, romantic morning in your beachfront villa. Order in-room breakfast and enjoy it on your private terrace overlooking the ocean. After breakfast, take a morning yoga class on the beach if offered by the resort (many Maldivian resorts offer complimentary morning yoga). Alternatively, take a peaceful walk along the sandbank at low tide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Traditional Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Tour. A local chef guides you through the preparation of authentic Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (tuna broth), mas huni, and coconut-based curries. The cultural tour component includes learning about Maldivian fishing traditions, island life, and the role of coconut in local cuisine. Duration approximately 3 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Dine on the dishes you prepared during the cooking class as part of the experience, or head to a local-style restaurant within the resort for a Maldivian-themed dinner night. Stroll along the illuminated beach path after dinner and enjoy the sound of the waves.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast on your private terrace — order fresh fruit platter, eggs, toast, and Maldivian tea (sai) from room service.
meals.lunch: Light snack during or after the cooking class — taste the dishes you prepare as part of the experience.
meals.dinner: Local Maldivian cuisine night at the resort's cultural dining venue — try rihaakuru (fish paste) with flatbread, tuna curry, and coconut pudding for dessert. Budget approx. $50–$75 for two.

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class is a wonderful cultural immersion experience, especially meaningful for honeymooners wanting to connect with local traditions. Book in advance through the resort. Wear comfortable, loose clothing. This is also a great day to purchase local spices and coconut products as souvenirs from the resort's gift shop.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the resort's house reef before the crowds arrive. The early morning light creates magical underwater visibility. Look for octopus, moray eels, and sleeping reef sharks in the coral crevices. Return for a hearty breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a half-day excursion to a nearby uninhabited sandbank island. Many Maldivian resorts arrange sandbank picnic trips where you can walk on a tiny strip of white sand surrounded entirely by turquoise water — a quintessential Maldives experience. Bring snorkel gear to explore the surrounding reef. Return to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a couples' spa experience at the resort's overwater spa. Choose a traditional Maldivian coconut and frangipani body scrub followed by a relaxing hot stone massage. Afterward, have a quiet dinner at the resort and enjoy an early evening stargazing session from your beachfront terrace.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort — fuel up before the active morning. Fresh juices, tropical fruits, and a hot egg station.
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic lunch included with the excursion — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit, and chilled water. If not included, pack snacks from the resort.
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner at the resort's à la carte restaurant — seafood pasta, a shared cheese board, and a bottle of local-label wine. Budget approx. $65–$90 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm the sandbank excursion the day before with the activities desk. Check tide times — sandbanks are most spectacular at low tide. The spa should be booked at least 1–2 days in advance, especially for couples' treatments. Stargazing is exceptional in the Maldives due to minimal light pollution — March skies are typically clear.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a lazy morning. Have breakfast delivered to your beachfront terrace. Spend the late morning reading, swimming in the lagoon, or simply lying in a hammock strung between palm trees. This is a dedicated relaxation day — no structured activities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's facilities at leisure. Take a swim in the infinity pool overlooking the ocean. Visit the resort's boutique to browse local crafts, Maldivian jewelry, and reef-safe sunscreen. Enjoy an afternoon cocktail at the overwater bar and watch the boats drift by.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — one of the most iconic and unforgettable dinners in the world. Descend below the ocean surface and dine surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels with marine life swimming all around you. This is a bucket-list honeymoon dinner. Book the early evening seating for the most dramatic light transition from dusk to night.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely in-room breakfast on the terrace — fresh tropical smoothie bowl, avocado toast, and Maldivian coconut pancakes.
meals.lunch: Poolside light lunch — club sandwich, fresh watermelon juice, and a shared dessert.
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — a set tasting menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood, lobster bisque, and a decadent chocolate dessert. Budget approx. $120–$180 for two (this is a splurge meal — justified for a honeymoon).

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is one of the most sought-after dining experiences in the Maldives — book this as early as possible, ideally before arrival. Dress code is typically smart casual (no flip-flops). Arrive 15 minutes early to be escorted down. This will be the most memorable dinner of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided dolphin watching excursion. The waters around the Maldivian atolls are home to spinner dolphins and bottlenose dolphins. A morning boat trip offers the best chance of sightings as dolphins are most active in the early hours. The excursion typically lasts 2–3 hours and often includes a snorkeling stop at a nearby reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for lunch. Spend the afternoon at the resort's water sports center — try a new activity such as windsurfing, kitesurfing introduction, or a glass-bottom kayak tour over the lagoon. The glass-bottom kayak allows you to see the reef below without getting wet.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beach dinner set up privately on the sand by the resort team. Many mid-range Maldivian resorts offer private beach dining arrangements with advance booking — a table for two on the sand, tiki torches, and a personalized menu. Perfect for a honeymoon milestone evening.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast before the dolphin excursion — keep it light with fruits, yogurt, and coffee.
meals.lunch: Casual beach grill after returning from the excursion — grilled mahi-mahi, coleslaw, and fresh lemonade.
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner arranged by the resort — 3-course set menu with lobster thermidor, champagne toast, and a dessert with a personalized honeymoon message. Budget approx. $90–$130 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Book the private beach dinner at least 2–3 days in advance and inform the resort it is for a honeymoon — they often add complimentary touches like rose petals and a personalized cake. The dolphin excursion should also be pre-booked. Bring a light jacket for the boat trip as early mornings can be breezy.

day_by_day.morning: Participate in a second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari, this time exploring a different reef system. With a guide, venture to deeper coral formations and look for larger marine life including nurse sharks, eagle rays, and hawksbill sea turtles. This second safari will feel more confident and rewarding as your snorkeling skills have improved over the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed afternoon. Visit the resort library or lounge area and read. Optional: Take a nap in your beachfront villa with the ocean breeze coming through the windows. Late afternoon, take a long walk along the full perimeter of the island at low tide — a peaceful and meditative experience.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the resort's cultural evening if scheduled (many Maldivian resorts host weekly Bodu Beru drumming and traditional dance performances). Enjoy dinner at the resort's main restaurant with a view of the performance.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast — stock up on protein before the snorkeling safari.
meals.lunch: Light post-snorkel lunch at the resort's beach café — fresh grilled fish wrap, coconut water, and a fruit salad.
meals.dinner: Resort main restaurant with cultural performance — Maldivian seafood platter to share, rice dishes, and a traditional coconut dessert. Budget approx. $55–$80 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Ask the activities desk about the weekly cultural evening schedule when you arrive. Bodu Beru drumming is a traditional Maldivian art form and a wonderful cultural experience. Bring your camera for the performance. The island walk at low tide is best around 16:00–17:30 — check the tide chart at the reception.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a morning of complete leisure — sleep in, lounge on your private beach, and enjoy the sounds of the ocean. This is your mid-trip rest day. Order a smoothie from the beach bar and read a book under a palm tree. Take a slow swim in the warm lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local inhabited island nearby via a resort-arranged day trip. Many Maldivian resorts organize excursions to neighboring local islands where you can visit a local school, a mosque, a fishing harbor, and small shops selling handmade lacquerwork and woven items. This provides a genuine glimpse into everyday Maldivian life beyond the resort bubble.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk. After dark, head to the shoreline to witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the water with a blue glow as waves crash. Walk barefoot along the water's edge and watch the ocean sparkle with every step. This is one of nature's most breathtaking displays.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast on your beachfront terrace — tropical fruit, granola with coconut milk, and freshly brewed coffee.
meals.lunch: On the local island day trip — try a local tea shop (sai hotel) for authentic Maldivian short eats: tuna rolls, bajiya (fried pastry), and sweet black tea. Very affordable and authentic.
meals.dinner: Resort dinner after the bioluminescent walk — keep it light and relaxed. Order from the resort's casual dining menu — grilled chicken skewers, mezze platter, and a mocktail. Budget approx. $45–$65 for two.

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescence is best viewed on nights with minimal moonlight — check the lunar calendar for March 23, 2027. The phenomenon is most visible between 21:00 and 23:00. The local island visit requires modest dress (cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local Islamic customs). Bring small USD bills for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Take a sunrise fishing trip with local Maldivian fishermen. Traditional Maldivian pole-and-line fishing (handline fishing) is a centuries-old practice. Head out on a small boat at dawn and try your hand at catching skipjack tuna. The experience is both exciting and deeply connected to Maldivian heritage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the fishing trip and have your catch prepared by the resort's chef for a personalized lunch — there is nothing more satisfying than eating fish you caught yourself. Spend the rest of the afternoon at the spa or relaxing by the pool. Optional: Book a sunset photography session with a resort photographer for a professional honeymoon photo shoot.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise or opt for a quiet sunset cocktail hour at the overwater bar. Dine at the resort's overwater restaurant for a final elevated dining experience before the trip winds down.

meals.breakfast: Very early light breakfast before the fishing trip — banana, energy bar, and coffee from the resort's early morning station.
meals.lunch: Your freshly caught fish prepared by the resort chef — grilled tuna with garlic butter, lemon rice, and a garden salad. A truly unique and memorable meal.
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — seafood risotto, grilled prawns, and a shared crème brûlée. Pair with a glass of white wine. Budget approx. $75–$100 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Book the sunrise fishing trip through the activities desk — it typically departs at 05:30–06:00. Bring motion sickness medication if you are prone to seasickness on small boats. The resort photography session should be booked 2 days in advance. Ask specifically for a golden hour session (17:00–18:30) for the best light.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final full snorkeling morning at the house reef. By now you are familiar with the reef and can explore independently. Look for species you may have missed earlier in the trip. Spend a long, unhurried time underwater and truly absorb the beauty of the coral ecosystem. Take underwater photos to document the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon pampering yourselves at the resort spa. Book a full couples' spa package — a combination of a Maldivian coconut scrub, a four-hand massage, and a relaxing floral bath drawn in your villa. This is the ultimate luxury honeymoon afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a stargazing session on the beach. Many Maldivian resorts offer guided stargazing with telescopes and narration about the Southern Hemisphere night sky. The Maldives sits just above the equator, offering a unique view of both hemispheres' constellations. Afterward, enjoy a quiet nightcap at the overwater bar.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast — enjoy every item on the buffet as a celebration of your penultimate full day.
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — fresh sushi rolls, miso soup, and a tropical fruit smoothie.
meals.dinner: Casual but delicious dinner at the resort's beach grill — whole grilled snapper, roasted vegetables, and a shared tiramisu. Budget approx. $60–$85 for two.

day_by_day.notes: This is your second-to-last full day — make the most of every moment. Confirm your departure logistics today: check your flight time, arrange resort checkout, and confirm the transfer to the airport or seaplane terminal. Begin packing non-essentials tonight. The floral bath in your villa should be arranged with the spa and villa butler in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Maldives. Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach — sit quietly with a coffee and watch the sky turn pink and gold over the Indian Ocean. Take a final swim in the warm lagoon. Pack your bags and complete the checkout process.
day_by_day.afternoon: If checkout time permits (typically 12:00), spend the final hours at the beach or pool. Use the resort's day-use facilities after checkout if your transfer is in the afternoon. Visit the resort gift shop for last-minute souvenirs — Maldivian lacquerwork (liyelaa), locally made jewelry, reef-safe sunscreen, and Maldivian spice packets.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Aegean Bliss Resort via speedboat or seaplane transfer to Velana International Airport. Allow ample time for the transfer and airport check-in. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days in one of the world's most beautiful destinations. Board your departure flight with memories that will last a lifetime.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at the resort — order your favorite items from the entire trip one last time. Splurge on the freshly squeezed juices and made-to-order eggs.
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort's casual café before checkout — fish burger, sweet potato fries, and a farewell coconut water.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Velana International Airport — try the airport's local Maldivian café for a final plate of short eats and Maldivian tea before boarding.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer time with the resort at least 24 hours before. The speedboat or seaplane transfer to Malé can take 20–90 minutes depending on your resort's location — factor this into your airport arrival time. Ensure you have settled all resort bills the evening before to avoid a rushed checkout. Keep all boarding passes and travel documents accessible.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day — in transit. Depending on your departure flight time and routing, you may be in the air or at a connecting airport. If you have a long layover, use airport lounge facilities to rest and refresh.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue travel home. Use this time to review your photos, write a travel journal entry, or simply rest and recover. The Maldives trip will already feel like a beautiful dream.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home. Unpack your memories along with your luggage. Begin planning your next adventure inspired by the magic of the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Airport or in-flight breakfast.
meals.lunch: In-flight meal or airport dining at your connection hub.
meals.dinner: In-flight dinner or home-cooked meal upon arrival.

day_by_day.notes: This is a travel/buffer day built into the itinerary. Use it to decompress from the trip. Ensure all resort charges are reconciled on your credit card. Submit any travel insurance claims if applicable. Rate your experiences on TripAdvisor or Google to help future travelers. Welcome home — and congratulations on your honeymoon.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn golden over the Indian Ocean. Perfect for couples seeking a romantic and intimate experience unique to the Maldives.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the most vibrant and pristine coral reefs in the world on a guided snorkeling safari. Swim alongside sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. A professional guide ensures safety and points out rare marine life, making it an unforgettable underwater adventure.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels revealing a breathtaking coral reef ecosystem. Enjoy a curated five-course gourmet meal featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine while fish and rays glide past your table — the ultimate luxury honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Ithaa Undersea Restaurant, Conrad Maldives Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline in electric blue hues. Walk hand-in-hand along the glowing beach, wade into the warm glittering water, and capture stunning photographs of this rare and romantic natural spectacle that the Maldives is world-famous for.

experiences.name: Traditional Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Tour
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut flatbreads. Follow the class with a guided village walk to explore local crafts, mosques, and the vibrant fishing culture of the islands.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. A dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler will greet you with a welcome garland and assist with luggage. Transfer via private luxury speedboat to Aegean Bliss Resort (approximately 30–45 min scenic night transfer). Check in to your Beachfront villa with a chilled welcome drink and light refreshments prepared in your room.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or at airport
meals.lunch: In-flight or at airport
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome amenity platter and sparkling wine prepared in your villa by the resort butler upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is late night — keep Day 1 completely relaxed. Unpack, freshen up, and enjoy the sound of the Indian Ocean from your private beachfront terrace. Early rest is recommended to enjoy a full Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely private breakfast on your villa's beachfront deck as the sun rises over the turquoise lagoon. Take a gentle orientation walk along the resort's pristine sandbanks to familiarize yourself with the property and discover the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Settle into paradise with a relaxing afternoon at your private beachfront. Take a dip in your villa's plunge pool or wade into the crystal-clear lagoon. Visit the resort's overwater spa for a welcome couple's massage — the 'Ocean Harmony' treatment uses locally sourced coconut oil and sea botanicals.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with tropical flowers and candles. Sip champagne as the sun melts into the horizon, surrounded by the golden hues of the Indian Ocean. Return to the resort for a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Private beachfront breakfast at your villa — fresh tropical fruits, eggs benedict, pastries, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian black tea
meals.lunch: Casual poolside lunch at the resort's main infinity pool bar — grilled lobster sliders, fresh ceviche, and tropical smoothies
meals.dinner: Romantic candlelit private beach dinner featuring fresh catch of the day, saffron-infused risotto, and a decadent chocolate lava cake with champagne pairing

day_by_day.notes: This is your first full day — prioritize rest and gentle exploration. Inform the butler of any dietary restrictions or special romantic preferences for the week ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari: Set out with a certified marine biologist guide on a private snorkeling excursion to the resort's premier coral gardens. Discover vibrant staghorn and brain corals, sea turtles, manta rays, and schools of tropical fish in the pristine house reef and surrounding lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the villa for a light lunch and a relaxed afternoon. Explore the resort's library of water sports — try stand-up paddleboarding or kayaking along the calm lagoon. Alternatively, indulge in a private yoga session on the overwater platform with a certified instructor.
day_by_day.evening: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience: Descend into one of the world's most iconic dining settings — a fully submerged restaurant surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels offering 270-degree views of the coral reef and marine life. Enjoy a curated tasting menu with wine pairings as reef sharks and rays glide past your table.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — smoked salmon bagels, acai bowls, freshly brewed Maldivian coffee, and a tropical fruit platter
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch — grilled fish tacos, watermelon and feta salad, and chilled coconut water served at the shoreline
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant: 6-course tasting menu featuring seared scallops, lobster bisque, wagyu beef tenderloin, and a passion fruit soufflé with sommelier-curated wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Restaurant well in advance — this is one of the resort's most sought-after experiences. Snorkeling equipment is provided; reef-safe sunscreen is mandatory and available at the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Traditional Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Tour: Join a local chef for an immersive hands-on cooking class in the resort's open-air kitchen. Learn to prepare authentic Maldivian dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and hedhikaa (local snacks). Follow with a guided cultural tour of local fishing techniques and island traditions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a private sandbank picnic arranged by your butler. A short boat ride takes you to a secluded uninhabited sandbank where a luxury picnic setup awaits — cushioned seating, chilled rosé, gourmet bites, and a parasol. Swim in the surrounding turquoise shallows in total privacy.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Enjoy sunset cocktails at the overwater bar before a sophisticated dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant overlooking the lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Cooking class doubles as a late breakfast — enjoy the dishes you prepare during the class, including fresh roshi flatbread and mas huni
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — artisan charcuterie boards, fresh sashimi, tropical fruit skewers, macarons, and chilled rosé champagne
meals.dinner: Resort signature restaurant — pan-seared mahi-mahi with lemongrass coconut broth, truffle-infused reef lobster, and a coconut panna cotta with mango coulis

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic requires advance booking through your butler. Bring a waterproof camera — the sandbank scenery is extraordinary for photography.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise dolphin watching cruise. Board a private speedboat before dawn and head to the open ocean where spinner dolphins are frequently spotted leaping alongside the boat in the golden morning light. Return in time for a leisurely brunch.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a full couple's spa afternoon at the resort's overwater spa pavilion. Begin with a traditional Maldivian 'Dhivehi Beys' herbal body scrub followed by a 90-minute deep tissue or hot stone couple's massage. Conclude with a private hydrotherapy soak overlooking the ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk: After dark, take a guided walk along the shoreline to witness the breathtaking natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton illuminating the waves and sand with an ethereal blue glow. A magical and deeply romantic experience unique to the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-cruise snack pack provided on the boat — granola bars, tropical fruits, and thermos of coffee
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant brunch — eggs royale, smoked tuna benedict, fresh juices, and a Maldivian coconut cake
meals.dinner: Intimate in-villa private dining experience — a chef comes to your villa to prepare a personalized 4-course dinner on your beachfront terrace under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent phenomenon is most visible on moonless nights — your butler can advise on optimal timing. The private in-villa chef dinner must be arranged 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning completely at leisure. Sleep in, order an extravagant in-villa breakfast, and spend the morning reading or lounging on your private beachfront with the gentle sound of the ocean as your backdrop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (second excursion to a different reef site): Join your marine biologist guide for a second snorkeling safari exploring a distinct coral garden location with different marine biodiversity — look out for whale sharks (seasonal), Napoleon wrasse, and vibrant nudibranch sea slugs.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise (second experience — themed differently): Tonight's dhoni cruise is styled as a private stargazing voyage. Drift into the open ocean away from light pollution, where your guide uses a laser pointer to trace constellations while you sip premium whisky and enjoy artisan cheese and charcuterie under a canopy of stars.

meals.breakfast: Lavish in-villa breakfast — eggs any style, smoked fish, pastry basket, fresh juices, and a mimosa to start the day
meals.lunch: Beachfront grill — whole grilled snapper with garlic herb butter, charred vegetables, and a crisp Sauvignon Blanc
meals.dinner: On the dhoni — gourmet charcuterie, aged cheeses, Maldivian honey, crackers, and premium whisky or champagne under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The stargazing dhoni experience is best on clear nights — confirm weather conditions with your butler in the afternoon. Bring a light wrap as ocean breezes can be cool after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — celebrate with a special morning excursion. Take a seaplane or private speedboat to a nearby uninhabited island for a guided nature walk. Explore mangroves, spot nesting seabirds, and learn about the Maldivian ecosystem from a local naturalist guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely afternoon. Treat yourselves to the resort's 'Royal Couple's Journey' spa package — a 3-hour immersive treatment including a floral bath ritual, full body wrap, facial, and scalp massage in a private overwater spa suite.
day_by_day.evening: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience (second visit — different menu): Return to the iconic underwater restaurant for a special 'Chef's Table' experience — a personalized menu created exclusively for you by the head chef, featuring the finest seasonal ingredients and a bespoke wine pairing curated by the sommelier.

meals.breakfast: Early continental breakfast before excursion — fresh pastries, tropical fruits, yogurt parfait, and strong Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch prepared by the resort and enjoyed on the uninhabited island — gourmet sandwiches, cold lobster, tropical fruits, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant Chef's Table — fully personalized 7-course tasting menu with bespoke wine pairing; expect highlights like Maldivian lobster thermidor, black truffle arancini, and a showstopping dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: The Chef's Table requires booking at least 48 hours in advance and is subject to availability. This is the perfect occasion to celebrate your honeymoon with a special cake or champagne surprise arranged through the butler.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling from your beachfront villa — simply step off your private deck and explore the house reef at your own pace. Spot sea turtles, reef sharks, and colorful fish in the calm morning waters before the day heats up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Traditional Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Tour (extended edition): Participate in a deeper cultural immersion — visit the resort's on-site herb and vegetable garden with the chef, then craft a full Maldivian feast including rihaakuru (fish paste), bondi (coconut milk curry), and traditional sweet treats.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic evening at the resort's overwater cocktail lounge. Watch the sunset with expertly crafted signature cocktails — try the 'Maldivian Sunset' made with local arrack, passion fruit, and coconut cream. Follow with dinner at the resort's Mediterranean-influenced restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Post-snorkel breakfast at the beach café — avocado toast with smoked tuna, granola bowls, fresh coconut water, and tropical smoothies
meals.lunch: The dishes prepared during the cooking class — a full authentic Maldivian spread enjoyed with the chef and resort cultural team
meals.dinner: Mediterranean overwater restaurant — burrata with heirloom tomatoes, grilled octopus, slow-roasted lamb rack with rosemary jus, and a tiramisu with espresso martini

day_by_day.notes: Morning snorkeling is best done between 6:30–8:30 AM when visibility is highest and marine life is most active. Request reef-safe sunscreen and fins from the villa attendant the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga and meditation session on the beach led by the resort's wellness instructor. Breathe in the salt air, stretch, and center yourselves for the day ahead. Follow with a nourishing wellness breakfast at the spa café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a private big-game fishing excursion in the open Indian Ocean. Your experienced local captain will guide you to prime fishing grounds where yellowfin tuna, wahoo, and dorado are abundant. Catch-and-release or have your catch prepared by the resort chef for dinner.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk (second experience — different beach section): Explore a different stretch of the island's coastline after dark to witness bioluminescent plankton once more, this time with a private photographer to capture the magical blue glow and your silhouettes against the luminescent sea.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga wellness breakfast — smoothie bowls, chia pudding, poached eggs on grain toast, herbal teas, and cold-pressed juices at the spa café
meals.lunch: On the fishing boat — packed gourmet lunch box with sandwiches, fresh fruit, energy bars, and chilled beverages
meals.dinner: Resort grill restaurant — your freshly caught fish prepared to your specification (grilled, pan-seared, or ceviche-style) with seasonal sides and a crisp white wine

day_by_day.notes: The private photographer for the bioluminescent walk must be arranged in advance through the resort's concierge. Images will be professionally edited and delivered digitally as a keepsake of your honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: Full leisure morning — your most unstructured day of the trip. Sleep as late as you wish, enjoy a long breakfast, and simply bask in the beauty of your beachfront villa. This is your day to do absolutely nothing — or everything — as you please.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise (third experience — snorkeling edition): A daytime dhoni excursion to a remote, rarely visited coral reef accessible only by boat. Snorkel in pristine, untouched waters with your marine biologist guide, then anchor and enjoy a floating champagne lunch on the dhoni.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a luxurious private jacuzzi soak on your villa terrace as the stars emerge. Order a curated room service dinner and dine in ultimate privacy on your beachfront deck — the most intimate evening of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Extended in-villa breakfast — a full à la carte spread delivered to your beachfront terrace including eggs, pastries, tropical fruits, smoked fish, and bottomless coffee
meals.lunch: Floating champagne lunch on the dhoni — cold lobster, fresh sashimi, tropical fruit, artisan bread, and Moët & Chandon
meals.dinner: Premium in-villa room service — surf and turf (grilled lobster tail and wagyu beef fillet), truffle fries, a decadent chocolate fondue for two, and a bottle of Barolo

day_by_day.notes: This is intentionally your most relaxed day — no early alarms, no schedules. Embrace the slow luxury of the Maldives. Arrange the evening room service order with your butler by mid-afternoon.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (third excursion — night snorkeling): Experience the reef in a completely different light with a guided night snorkeling session in the early morning hours just before dawn. Witness nocturnal marine creatures — hunting reef sharks, sleeping parrotfish, and glowing jellyfish — with underwater torches.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's boutique for curated Maldivian crafts, jewelry, and keepsakes. Spend the afternoon at leisure — perhaps a final spa treatment, a paddleboard session, or simply floating in the lagoon. Attend a complimentary resort mixology class and learn to craft signature Maldivian cocktails.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell romantic dinner: A special private beachfront dinner arranged by your butler to celebrate your final full evening in paradise. A dedicated waiter, personalized menu, rose petals, lanterns, and a custom honeymoon cake await you under the Maldivian sky.

meals.breakfast: Pre-dawn light snack before night snorkeling — energy bars, bananas, and thermos of coffee; full breakfast after returning
meals.lunch: Post-snorkel brunch at the main restaurant — eggs florentine, smoked salmon platter, fresh juices, and a Bloody Mary
meals.dinner: Private farewell beach dinner — a 5-course personalized menu featuring the finest ingredients of the trip: Maldivian lobster, wagyu, a cheese course, and a custom honeymoon cake with sparklers

day_by_day.notes: Inform your butler at least 48 hours in advance about the farewell dinner so every detail — flower arrangements, cake design, music playlist — can be perfectly curated for your final night.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk along the beach — take in the breathtaking colors of a Maldivian dawn one last time. Collect a few shells as natural souvenirs. Enjoy a long, unhurried breakfast at your villa as you begin the gentle process of packing and preparing for departure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-out procedures and final moments at the resort. Your butler will assist with luggage and ensure all departure arrangements are seamless. Enjoy a farewell mocktail at the overwater bar before boarding your private speedboat transfer back to Malé.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer to Malé International Airport for onward journey. Depending on your departure flight time, explore Malé's waterfront promenade, visit the Grand Friday Mosque, or relax in an airport lounge with premium amenities.

meals.breakfast: Final grand villa breakfast — a celebratory spread with all your favorites from the week: tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, smoked fish, fresh juices, and champagne to toast the journey
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort before departure — fresh sushi rolls, a green papaya salad, and a chilled glass of white wine
meals.dinner: Airport lounge dinner or onboard dining depending on departure flight schedule

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer timing with your butler the evening before. Malé airport has a premium lounge with showers and dining — arrive early to unwind before your flight. Ensure all resort charges are settled and keepsake photos from the resort photographer are downloaded.

day_by_day.morning: In transit — homeward bound. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days in paradise. Review your photos, journal your memories, and begin planning your return to the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: In transit or arrived at home destination. Rest and recover from the journey.
